title: Production ML Systems Capstone
brief: Design and defend an end-to-end production ML system from problem framing and data through training, deployment, monitoring, retraining, platform integration, and responsible operation.
optional_kubernetes_extension: If the learner chooses M016-11, deploy the prediction service to Kubernetes with health/readiness, Service discovery, ConfigMaps/Secrets, monitoring hooks, and a safe rollout/rollback.
